name: inspira-direction-aware-hover
blurb: Card image reveal based on hover direction, with mobile touch support.
description: Card wrapper that detects entry edge and reveals image from that direction. Includes mobile touch support with 3-second auto-dismiss.
use_when: Interactive cards with directional image reveals that work on both desktop and touch devices.
avoid_when: When direction detection isn't supported or desired.
a11y: Detects hover and touch entry; image reveal has auto-dismiss on mobile.
